title: Windows: `import hashlib` loads user32.dll and the GDI DLLs through libcrypto; delay-load user32
author: azchohfi
body_preview: ### Description  On Windows, importing `hashlib` maps `user32.dll`, `gdi32.dll`, `gdi32full.dll`, `win32u.dll` and `imm32.dll` into the process.
